symptom: GitHub returned the unevaluated profile expression as the name of a skipped scheduled job. The hourly reader threw, blocking cloud PRs with hourly_unavailable before the first real canary green and preventing predecessor recovery.
rule: Use the actual skipped-job API shape. Recognize only the exact expression on a completed scheduled run with one matching completed, skipped, zero-step job. Preserve never-started and non-green semantics, Gate 0 isolation, trusted run identity, activation, freshness and signed predecessor ownership. Check the trusted-base landing path before claiming a reviewed marker can repair an unavailable snapshot.
